content: Install flow: /plugin marketplace add owner/repo (GitHub shorthand) or full git URL or ./local/path registers the marketplace; /plugin install <plugin-name>@<marketplace-name> installs a specific plugin, marketplace-name from marketplace.json's name field. Claude Code reuses existing git credential helpers (gh auth login, SSH agent, keychain). GitHub owner/repo shorthand clones over SSH by default (set CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS=1 to force HTTPS). Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces + community search corroboration.
